 Judgment
Learned counsel for the appellant-petitioner in MFA No.200068/2018 has filed a memo seeking permission for withdrawal of the appeal.
The memo is taken on record.
2. In view of the memo, the appeal in MFA No.200068/2018 is dismissed as withdrawn.

3. This appeal in MFA No.201611/2019 is filed by the appellant-petitioner challenging the judgment and award dated 15.12.2015 passed in MVC.No.1302/2013 by the learned Prl. Senior Civil Judge and MACT-V, Vijaypur (for short 'the Tribunal').
4.
Though this matter is listed for admission, it is taken up for final disposal.
5. For the sake of convenience, parties are referred to as per their ranking before the Claims Tribunal.

6. The learned counsel for the petitioner in MFA No.201611/2019 submits that the tribunal was not justified in awarding a sum of Rs.2,84,160/- only as against the reasonable claimed amount of Rs.16,00,000/-.
He further submits that the petitioner had sustained head injury and fracture of left clavicle and other injuries to all over the body.
The tribunal has considered only 6% disability so also the income of the petitioner considered by the tribunal is on the lower side.
Hence, on these grounds sought for enhancement of compensation.

7. Per contra, the learned counsel for the respondent- Insurance Company supports the judgment and award of the Tribunal and therefore contended that the judgment and award passed by the Tribunal be not disturbed.
Hence, prays to dismiss the appeal.

8. Having heard the arguments of the learned counsel for both parties and on perusal of records the following points would arise for consideration:
(1) Whether the petitioner is entitled for enhancement of compensation as sought for?
(2) What order/award?
9.

pm.

16. The petitioner has not produced any evidence with regard to his income.
